findings.evidence: Lines 101-117 define the instance plus `smul_YQ`…`smul_Ye`; `grep -n "MulAction\|one_smul\|smul_smul" Representation.lean` returns nothing. It is the only bare `SMul` instance in `EpsilonEridani/`.
findings.fix: Add `instance : MulAction ℚ GenerationAssignments` next to it (`one_smul`/`mul_smul` close by `intros; ext <;> simp [mul_assoc]`), which is the operation's characteristic API.
findings.issue: `instance : SMul ℚ GenerationAssignments` is exposed with only the five projection lemmas and none of its characteristic laws. `1 • a = a` and `q • (r • a) = (q * r) • a` are unavailable, so a consumer of the headline theorem `isAnomalyFree_iff_exists_eq_smul_standardModel` (line 253) who holds `a = q • standardModel` cannot rescale back (`standardModel = q⁻¹ • a`) without re-deriving the instance by hand.

findings.evidence: Lines 176, 184, 190, 201 list `quarkDoublet, upSinglet, downSinglet, leptonDoublet, electronSinglet`; lines 220 (`norm_num [standardModel]`), 271 and 276 list `standardModel`. Contrast line 120 `@[simps] def swapQuarkSinglets`, whose generated `swapQuarkSinglets_YQ` etc. are cited by name at lines 238 and 274.
findings.fix: Put `@[simps]` on the five multiplet defs and on `standardModel`, then drop those names from the `simp only` lists at lines 176-203, 220, 271-276.
findings.issue: `quarkDoublet`, `upSinglet`, `downSinglet`, `leptonDoublet`, `electronSinglet` (lines 124-136) and `standardModel` (line 215) have no projection lemmas, unlike `swapQuarkSinglets` (line 121, `@[simps]`). Every proof reaches their fields by putting the definition name in a `simp only` list, i.e. by unfolding the exposed body; a consumer asking for `a.upSinglet.Y` or `standardModel.YQ` has no lemma to cite.

findings.evidence: Line 63-65 defines `Chirality.sign` by pattern match; `Chirality.sign` appears as a simp-set entry at lines 176, 185, 190, 201 and nowhere as the LHS of a lemma.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem Chirality.sign_left : Chirality.left.sign = 1 := rfl` and `@[simp] theorem Chirality.sign_right : Chirality.right.sign = -1 := rfl`, and remove `Chirality.sign` from the `simp only` lists.
findings.issue: `Chirality.sign` has no simp lemmas for its two values, so `Chirality.left.sign` does not reduce under plain `simp`; the file instead unfolds the definition in four proofs.

summary: The two substantive prior findings (uniqueness via `standardModel`, aggregate SMACCs bridge) are fixed and the `accCube_toSMCharges` simp contest is accepted. Remaining: the new `SMul ℚ` instance carries none of its laws, and six structure-valued defs have no projection lemmas, so every use goes through unfolding the exposed body.
